# Ford–Fulkerson Algorithm

## Ford–Fulkerson Algorithm

The Ford–Fulkerson algorithm makes use of a flow network to describe a network of vertices and edges with a source (S) and a sink (T).

![Flow Network  Graph in Ford–Fulkerson Algorithm](data:image/png;base64,)

Let's use the previous example of water flow in a network of hoses:

Each vertex, except S and T, can receive and send water through it. S can only send and T can only receive stuff.
